plugin.name: example_analysis
plugin.description: Group sequential gates by the net that drives their clock pin (reference output of tools/new_plugin.py).

netlist.description: The analysis reads clock pins of sequential gate types, so a netlist whose gate library declares no sequential type is out of scope rather than clean.

supported_gate_libraries.note: Library independent: the analysis asks the gate types for their properties and pin types instead of matching type names.

entry_points.name: analyze
entry_points.summary: Group sequential gates by the net that drives their clock pin.

entry_points.name: analyze
entry_points.summary: Same entry point through the bindings, raising RuntimeError with the plugin error message.

resources.complexity: linear in the number of gates

notes: Structural only. A clock domain here is the set of gates whose clock pin is driven by the same net, which is not the same thing as a verified clock domain: buffers and gated clocks split one physical domain into several nets.
